%% Figure 4.14 - PSM Assessment System class diagram (normalised design).
%%
%% The logical model: `User` holds identity and authentication only, and
%% every role has its own table joined 1:1 to it. This differs from the
%% implementing schema, where `users` also carries staff attributes and
%% only student and supervisor have a profile table. The chapter presents
%% this as the design; `class_diagram_implemented.txt` is what runs.
%%
%% Generated by .workbuddy-ai/make_class_diagram_normalised.py.

    'lineColor': '#333333',
    'edgeLabelBackground': '#ffffff'
  }
}}%%

    direction TB

    %% UC-01 - Identity - table `users`
    class User{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        name : varchar(255)
        email : varchar(255)
        password : varchar(255)
        roleId : bigint <<FK>>
        status : varchar(255)
        phone : varchar(32)
        lastLoginAt : timestamp
        failedLoginAttempts : smallint
        lockedUntil : timestamp
        mustChangePassword : boolean
    }

    %% UC-01 - Identity - table `roles`
    class Role{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        code : varchar(16)
        label : varchar(64)
        description : text
    }

    %% UC-02 - Role - table `admin_profiles`
    class AdminProfile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        staffId : varchar(32)
        department : varchar(128)
        scope : varchar(32)
    }

    %% UC-02 - Role - table `coordinator_profiles`
    class CoordinatorProfile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        staffId : varchar(32)
        department : varchar(128)
        isHead : boolean
    }

    %% UC-02 - Role - table `lecturer_profiles`
    class LecturerProfile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        staffId : varchar(32)
        department : varchar(128)
        courseCode : varchar(16)
    }

    %% UC-02 - Role - table `supervisor_profiles`
    class SupervisorProfile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        staffId : varchar(32)
        department : varchar(128)
        programCode : varchar(8)
        academicTitle : varchar(64)
        capacityPsm1 : smallint
        capacityPsm2 : smallint
    }

    %% UC-02 - Role - table `student_profiles`
    class StudentProfile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        matricNo : varchar(32)
        programCode : varchar(8)
        batch : varchar(32)
        yearOfStudy : smallint
        sectionId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% UC-05 - Role - table `coordinator_scopes`
    class CoordinatorScope{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        coordinatorProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        program : varchar(128)
    }

    %% UC-04 - Teaching - table `sections`
    class Section{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        code : varchar(16)
        name : varchar(128)
        courseCode : varchar(16)
        lecturerProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% UC-04 - Teaching - table `lecturer_marks`
    class LecturerMark{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        sectionId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        affective : numeric
        cognitive : numeric
        psychomotor : numeric
        enteredByUserId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% UC-02 - Registration - table `supervisor_agreements`
    class SupervisorAgreement{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        supervisorProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        proposedTitle1 : varchar(255)
        agreedTitle : varchar(255)
        status : varchar(255)
        studentSignedAt : timestamp
        supervisorAcknowledgedAt : timestamp
    }

    %% UC-02 - Registration - table `supervision_assignments`
    class SupervisionAssignment{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        supervisorProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        isActive : boolean
        effectiveFrom : date
        effectiveUntil : date
    }

    %% UC-02 - Registration - table `student_enrolments`
    class StudentEnrolment{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        attemptNo : smallint
        status : varchar(32)
        repeatsEnrolmentId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% UC-02 - Registration - table `project_members`
    class ProjectMember{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        isLeader : boolean
    }

    %% UC-04 - Registration - table `examiner_pairs`
    class ExaminerPair{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        name : varchar(64)
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        examiner1ProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        examiner2ProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        isActive : boolean
    }

    %% UC-04 - Registration - table `examiner_assignments`
    class ExaminerAssignment{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        examinerProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        examinerPairId : bigint <<FK>>
        panelRole : varchar(32)
        isActive : boolean
    }

    %% UC-03 - Chain - table `projects`
    class Project{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        title : varchar(255)
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        status : varchar(255)
        agreementId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% UC-03 - Chain - table `milestones`
    class Milestone{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        attempt : smallint
        status : varchar(32)
        dueAt : date
    }

    %% UC-03 - Chain - table `milestone_reviews`
    class MilestoneReview{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        reviewerProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        roundNo : smallint
        ackReceived : boolean
        ackReviewed : boolean
        verdict : varchar(32)
        totalScore : numeric
        maxScore : numeric
    }

    %% UC-03 - Chain - table `submission_files`
    class SubmissionFile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        uploadedByUserId : bigint <<FK>>
        originalName : varchar(255)
        revisionNo : smallint
        isCurrent : boolean
    }

    %% UC-02 - Chain - table `lampiran_b_forms`
    class LampiranBForm{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        supervisorProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        revisionNo : smallint
        title : varchar(255)
        status : varchar(32)
        rejectedReason : text
    }

    %% UC-04 - Assessment - table `rubric_templates`
    class RubricTemplate{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        formCode : varchar(8)
        psmPart : varchar(20)
        assessorType : varchar(20)
        version : smallint
        totalMarks : numeric
        isPublished : boolean
    }

    %% UC-04 - Assessment - table `rubric_components`
    class RubricComponent{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        rubricTemplateId : bigint <<FK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        title : varchar(255)
        weightPercent : numeric
        sequence : smallint
    }

    %% UC-04 - Assessment - table `rubric_criteria`
    class RubricCriterion{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        rubricComponentId : bigint <<FK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        title : varchar(255)
        weightPercent : numeric
        maxMarks : numeric
    }

    %% UC-04 - Assessment - table `assessment_windows`
    class AssessmentWindow{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        formCode : varchar(16)
        psmPart : varchar(16)
        status : varchar(16)
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        openedAt : timestamp
        closedAt : timestamp
    }

    %% UC-04 - Assessment - table `evaluations`
    class Evaluation{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        assessorProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        rubricTemplateId : bigint <<FK>>
        assessorType : varchar
        status : varchar
        rawScore : numeric
        maxScore : numeric
        scorePercent : numeric
    }

    %% UC-04 - Assessment - table `evaluation_scores`
    class EvaluationScore{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        evaluationId : bigint <<FK>>
        rubricComponentId : bigint <<FK>>
        rubricCriterionId : bigint <<FK>>
        itemScore : smallint
        marks : numeric
    }

    %% UC-05 - Results - table `final_grades`
    class FinalGrade{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        finalMark : numeric
        releasedAt : timestamp
        releasedByUserId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% UC-05 - Results - table `mark_submissions`
    class MarkSubmission{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        finalGradeId : bigint <<FK>>
        status : varchar(255)
        expectedPanelSize : smallint
    }

    %% UC-05 - Results - table `grade_schemes`
    class GradeScheme{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        passMark : numeric
    }

    %% UC-06 - Term - table `academic_semesters`
    class AcademicSemester{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        name : varchar(255)
        isActive : boolean
        startsAt : date
        endsAt : date
    }

    %% UC-01 - Term - table `audit_logs`
    class AuditLog{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        actorUserId : bigint <<FK>>
        action : varchar(64)
        subjectType : varchar(64)
        properties : json
        createdAt : timestamp
    }

    %% UC-06 - Term - table `notifications`
    class DatabaseNotification{
        id : uuid <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        type : varchar(255)
        readAt : timestamp
    }

    %% ---- Associations ----
    %% Every role table joins User 1:1. `*` marks a row where several
    %% `*_by` columns point at the same class.

    User "1" --> "0..1" Role : has
    User "1" --> "0..1" AdminProfile : is an administrator
    User "1" --> "0..1" CoordinatorProfile : is a coordinator
    User "1" --> "0..1" LecturerProfile : is a lecturer
    User "1" --> "0..1" SupervisorProfile : is a supervisor
    User "1" --> "0..1" StudentProfile : is a student
    CoordinatorProfile "1" *-- "0..*" CoordinatorScope : covers
    LecturerProfile "0..1" --> "0..*" Section : teaches
    Section "1" --> "0..*" LecturerMark : records
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" LecturerMark : earns
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..1" Section : sits in
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" StudentEnrolment : holds
    AcademicSemester "1" --> "0..*" StudentEnrolment : enrols
    StudentEnrolment "1" --> "0..1" Project : starts
    StudentEnrolment "0..1" --> "0..*" StudentEnrolment : repeats
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" SupervisorAgreement : files
    SupervisorProfile "1" --> "0..*" SupervisorAgreement : signs
    SupervisorAgreement "1" --> "0..1" Project : becomes
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" SupervisionAssignment : paired by
    SupervisorProfile "1" --> "0..*" SupervisionAssignment : supervises
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" ProjectMember : has
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" ProjectMember : takes part as
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" Milestone : carries
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" LampiranBForm : files
    Milestone "0..1" --> "0..*" LampiranBForm : carried by
    SupervisorProfile "1" --> "0..*" LampiranBForm : files for
    Milestone "1" *-- "0..*" SubmissionFile : holds
    Milestone "1" *-- "0..*" MilestoneReview : reviewed by
    User "1" --> "0..*" SubmissionFile : uploads
    SupervisorProfile "0..1" --> "0..*" MilestoneReview : reviews
    RubricTemplate "1" *-- "0..*" RubricComponent : contains
    RubricComponent "1" *-- "0..*" RubricCriterion : breaks into
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" Evaluation : assessed by
    SupervisorProfile "1" --> "0..*" Evaluation : assesses
    RubricTemplate "1" --> "0..*" Evaluation : governs
    Evaluation "1" *-- "0..*" EvaluationScore : scores
    RubricComponent "0..1" --> "0..*" EvaluationScore : measured by
    RubricCriterion "0..1" --> "0..*" EvaluationScore : measured by
    AcademicSemester "1" --> "0..*" AssessmentWindow : runs
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" ExaminerAssignment : panel of
    SupervisorProfile "1" --> "0..*" ExaminerAssignment : examines
    StudentProfile "0..1" --> "0..*" ExaminerAssignment : seated for
    ExaminerPair "0..1" --> "0..*" ExaminerAssignment : seats
    AcademicSemester "0..1" --> "0..*" ExaminerPair : pairs in
    SupervisorProfile "1" *-- "0..*" ExaminerPair : examiner 1 / examiner 2
    Project "1" --> "0..1" FinalGrade : results in
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" FinalGrade : awarded
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" MarkSubmission : closed by
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" MarkSubmission : submits
    FinalGrade "0..1" --> "0..*" MarkSubmission : published by
    Project "1" --> "0..*" GradeScheme : graded under
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" Project : created or approved by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" SupervisorAgreement : decided by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" SupervisionAssignment : assigned by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" ExaminerPair : created by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" ExaminerAssignment : assigned by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" LampiranBForm : rejected by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" AssessmentWindow : opened, closed or created by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" RubricTemplate : created by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" GradeScheme : created by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" MarkSubmission : opened or locked by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" FinalGrade : releases or locks *
    User "1" --> "0..*" AuditLog : acts
    User "1" --> "0..*" DatabaseNotification : receives
    User "1" --> "0..*" LecturerMark : keys
    AcademicSemester "1" --> "0..*" Section : provisions
    AcademicSemester "1" --> "0..*" StudentProfile : cohort of
    AcademicSemester "0..1" --> "0..*" Project : placed in
    AcademicSemester "0..1" --> "0..*" MarkSubmission : closed in
